description: Consistency-based MSA (T-Coffee; Notredame, Higgins & Heringa 2000): primary library of global (Needleman-Wunsch) and local (Smith-Waterman) pairwise alignments weighted by percent identity, triplet extension (direct weight + sum of min(W1, W2) over third sequences), progressive alignment along a UPGMA guide tree with the extended weights as position-specific scores and zero gap penalties. The scoring parameters only seed the pairwise library; totalScore is the ordinary column sum-of-pairs score.

sequences.description: DNA sequences to align (at least one).

gapExtend.description: Gap penalty charged per gap position.

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA.

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a nucleotide beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Column sum-of-pairs score of the MSA (match/mismatch from the matrix, residue-gap = gapExtend, gap-gap = 0).
